notes.title: Update notes December Update 24
notes.content:
We are hard at work improving our playtest build with all the feedback from you! ːsteamthumbsupː

This patch includes the following changes and fixes:

- Fixed some level issues with clipping
- Fixed a problem with the Bremer Puzzle
- Fixed an issue with levels not loading
- Add some inputs to keyboard for better UX
- Big update to the level streaming setup
- Overall performance improvements

Have fun testing the new features and let us know in the discussion thread what you think: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3285430/discussions/0/4634862623030051730/]Feedback Steam discussion thread[/url]

Thank you all for your feedback that help us improve the game! ːsteamhappyː
